name: Alcalde
description: Alcalde is a unique three-player trick-taking game from Puerto Rico. It is an asymmetrical variant of Brisca where one player, the 'Alcalde' (Mayor), defends their position against two cooperating opponents. The Alcalde wields twice the cards and twice the play-power in every trick.

content.text: Alcalde is a unique three-player trick-taking game from Puerto Rico. It is an asymmetrical variant of Brisca where one player, the 'Alcalde' (Mayor), defends their position against two cooperating opponents. The Alcalde wields twice the cards and twice the play-power in every trick.

Rooted in the Spanish Brisca tradition, Alcalde evolved in Puerto Rico as a social game where the leader is challenged by a temporary alliance. Its name, 'Alcalde', reflects the local governance structure where the 'Mayor' must satisfy the points to retain their office.
40-card Spanish pack. Rank: Ace-3-King-Queen-Jack-7-6-5-4-2 (in order of power/value).
Alcalde deals 3 cards to each opponent and 6 cards to themselves. The next card is the 'Life' card (Trump indicator).

items.text: Fixed Alcalde: The same player remains Alcalde for a set number of hands regardless of score.
